# Limited to Limitless™ — Lisa Murphy, MBA (Keynote Speaker)

> Keynote speaker and former COO with 20+ years in leadership. Signature talks on
> reclaiming time with AI, turning fear into focus, and building businesses that scale
> without burning out the people who run them. Book Lisa for conferences, corporate
> events, association meetings, and leadership summits.

## About Lisa
Lisa Murphy, MBA — founder of Limited to Limitless™ and a former COO with 20+ years
leading and scaling operations (decades of experience, not a recent pivot). Her talks
land as practical systems audiences can use immediately, because she has run the
operations she speaks about.

## Signature keynotes
- **Reclaim Your Hours** — Using AI to cut the admin that eats your team's day
  (leading companies trimming overhead 50–75%); win back at least 30% of lost time.
- **Fear & Focus** — Channeling fear into focus and execution, rather than "overcoming" it.
- **Business Built Limitless** — Fortune 500-caliber planning for early-stage companies;
  now the basis of a college certification course.

## What sets her apart
- An operator on stage — she has run what she teaches
- Frameworks, not fluff — audiences leave with usable tools
- Diagnoses the real bottleneck (margin and structure), not the surface problem
- Every talk drives one clear next step

## Free resource (lead magnet)
The 10 biggest time leaks — a free 10-prompt pack (email triage, email replies,
calendar planning, referral asks, and more). Used independently, it wins back at least
30% of lost time.
